links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of LLM-generated patient education brochures
links.effect: ChatGPT lowest grade level (5.2 ± 0.8), Flesch Reading Ease 70.0 ± 5.1; Gemini and Claude at about 9th grade reading level.
links.quote: Gemini and Claude produced longer, more elaborate brochures that received higher reliability ratings (3.0 ± 0.0 and 3.0 ± 1.0, respectively) but were at higher reading levels (≈ 9th grade).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of five LLMs for generating chronic disease patient education materials, evaluating readability and reliability via standardized metrics without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
